critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3279 WhoCanVisitIn — accepts view_forcing as free-form str then re-validates in the handler (raises 400). Consider Literal['free','forced'] for automatic 422 at the schema layer (currently missing/invalid view_forcing → 422 from Pydantic OR 400 from handler depending on presence, mildly inconsistent).

server.py L3296 — silently filters unknown modes from payload.visit_modes without warning. If the créa sends {'visit_modes': ['bogus','public']} they will get {'visit_modes':['public']} back with no indication that 'bogus' was dropped. Minor UX; consider 400 on unknown mode instead of silent drop.

server.py — no rate-limit or audit-trail check that prevents a créa from locking themselves out (e.g., view_forcing='forced' + visit_modes=['private'] on a non-private device). Not blocking (créa always has bypass) but worth documenting.

WhoCanVisitBadge.jsx — minimum-1-selection is enforced by disabling the last-active toggle. Good. Consider adding a visible tooltip/hint explaining why it's disabled (currently only the disabled state, no aria-label).

Dashboard.js — export→visit flow now correctly uses setStoredViewMode + visitTargetKeyId. LGTM. Just make sure the storage helpers persist across a full page reload if the créa refreshes mid-visit (readVisitTargetKeyId is already wired in useDeviceIdentity per iter133).
